profile.name: Ryan Rademann
profile.intro: I speak with construction and real-estate leaders about artificial intelligence, technology strategy, and the operating decisions that make change real.
profile.bio: Ryan Rademann is a Partner at Wipfli LLP, where he leads construction and real-estate technology work for contractors and owners across North America. His focus is the space between technology strategy and field reality: how people, software, data, and now agents work together to finish projects.

topics: Agentic workflows and the future of work
